# Ardya Homestays

> Boutique coffee estate homestay in Balehalli, Chikkamagaluru district, Karnataka, India.

Ardya Homestays is an intimate 4-room boutique homestay surrounded by lush coffee hills in Balehalli, near Mudigere and Chikkamagaluru in Karnataka, India. The property offers nature retreats, authentic Malnad home-cooked meals, campfire evenings, and personalized travel itineraries across the Western Ghats.

## Quick Facts
- **Property Name:** Ardya Homestays
- **Location:** Near Sanjivini Vana, Mullunde, Balehalli, Kelgoor post, Karnataka 577111, India
- **Coordinates:** 13.0826° N, 75.6415° E
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/vKvFyDTN1DZ9L2XN6
- **Contact Phone:** +91 8277446061
- **WhatsApp:** +91 8277446061
- **Official Website:** https://ardyahomestays.com
- **Check-in Time:** 12:00 PM
- **Check-out Time:** 11:00 AM
- **Total Rooms:** 4 private rooms

## Room Categories & Accommodation
1. **Regular Rooms (Arabica):**
   - Units: Arabica 1, Arabica 2
   - Bed: 1 Queen Bed + extra mattress on request
   - Capacity: 2 to 4 guests per room
   - Amenities: Private en-suite washroom, 24/7 geyser hot water, coffee estate garden view
   - Pricing: From ₹1,500 per person per night (Stay Only) or ₹2,000 per person per night (Stay with All Meals)

2. **Premium Suites (Robusta):**
   - Units: Robusta Premium 1, Robusta Premium 2
   - Bed: 1 King Bed + extra mattress on request
   - Capacity: 2 to 4 guests per room
   - Amenities: Spacious layout, premium washroom fittings, 24/7 hot water, panoramic estate views
   - Pricing: From ₹2,000 per person per night (Stay Only) or ₹2,500 per person per night (Stay with All Meals)

## Pricing Packages
- **Stay Only Package:** ₹1,500 per person / night (Regular) or ₹2,000 per person / night (Premium). Includes morning coffee/tea and estate walk.
- **Stay with Meals Package:** ₹2,000 per person / night (Regular) or ₹2,500 per person / night (Premium). Includes breakfast, lunch, evening snacks with coffee/tea, and dinner (authentic Malnad cuisine, veg and non-veg options available).
- **Children Policy:** Children under 5 stay complimentary. Children aged 5–10 years are charged at 50% rate.

## Amenities & Highlights
- Direct plantation walk inside working coffee estate
- Evening campfire sessions
- Authentic home-cooked Malnad culinary experience
- Free on-premise vehicle parking
- Continuous hot water geysers in all en-suite washrooms
- High-speed internet access
- Power backup

## Nearby Attractions & Sightseeing
- **Day 1 Route:** Mullayanagiri Peak, Seethalayanagiri, Kavikal Gandi, Baba Budangiri, Honnamana Halla, Jhari Waterfalls
- **Day 2 Route:** Hebbe Falls, Deviramma Temple, Kalhatti Falls
- **Day 3 Route:** Belur & Halebidu Hoysala Temples, Yagachi Water Sports
- **Day 4 Route:** Kudremukha National Park, Kyathanamakki View Point, Kalasa Temple, Hornadu Annapoorneshwari Temple
- **Day 5 Route:** Hirekolale Lake, Ayyanakere Lake, Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary Safari

Guests can book directly without OTA commission fees by contacting host via WhatsApp or phone at +91 8277446061 or using the instant price calculator at https://ardyahomestays.com/booking.
